target_customer: Frontier voice AI labs and early-stage voice startups that buy speech training and evaluation data
problem: Voice model builders need high-quality, diverse, consented speech data. Panels collects it from vetted contributors in-house.
business_model: Dataset licensing, including exclusive rights and custom datasets

founders.name: Aaron Wenk
education: Princeton, Operations Research and Financial Engineering
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was a world champion and national champion rower and later a national champion cyclist.

founders.name: Jason Le
education: Princeton, Operations Research and Financial Engineering
previous_startups: Helped build startups to millions of users (unnamed)
founders.background_notes: YC page shows first name Jason only and says he taught NLP at Princeton; surname Le from a YC launch page search summary.

competitors.name: David AI
competitors.what: Channel-separated natural conversation audio datasets for AI labs
competitors.traction_then: Claims proprietary catalog and customer labs; customers not publicly named

technical_complexity.rationale: Mainly operations: recruiting and vetting contributors, collection tooling, QA and transcription. Little novel technology.

defensibility.rationale: Exclusive datasets and a contributor network give some advantage, but the model is a data vendor service competing with funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: David AI raised a 50M Series B in October 2025 per Bloomberg, so a funded rival scaled quickly; no incumbent action against Panels is documented.

market_need_then: Voice AI labs needed more training and evaluation audio in 2025, and rival David AI raised 5M seed in January 2025 and later 50M, which indicates real spend. No Panels revenue is public.

branding.domain_note: Uses usepanels.com, a prefix domain, rather than panels.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain B2B tone about vetted contributors and data quality

brand_strength.rationale: A generic word shared by many products (Drupal Panels, panel apps) and no brand press or community found.

outcome_analysis: Panels is an active Summer 2025 company with no public funding or exit found. It sells speech datasets to voice labs and claims a network of over 10,000 contributors across 100 plus countries, but those are company claims, and a better funded rival, David AI, was scaling in the same niche.
notes: Two funding searches found no round for Panels; the Crunchbase page found belongs to a different company called Panels. Team size shows 1 on the YC page while two founders are named.
